milestone: 0.1.5 release: session grouping plus session-scoped bulk archive
whatChanged: Review list groups items by session; the groups themselves stay collapsible and every artifact remains reachable.

A session group can be archived in one step. The host accepts only action=archive for a session-scoped bulk request and returns 400 otherwise, so the bulk path cannot be used to approve or return without a human decision.
Bulk archive is reversible per artifact; each archived item keeps its own history entry.

inProductVerification.environment: isolated DSH_HOME with a copy of the real 75-item daily-profile state

dshDefault.failure: The pnpm bundled with DSH is pinned to registry.npmmirror.com and ignores npm_config_registry. That mirror answered 500 ER_NO_SUCH_TABLE for every package probed (react, dsh-plugin-catalog, dsh-bili-scroll, this one), so it is a mirror-side outage rather than a package problem. Resolution still fell back to the mirror's cached 0.1.3, and requesting 0.1.5 explicitly failed with ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION.

catalogState.note: The catalog still records 0.1.3 even though 0.1.4 was published hours earlier. The rebuild pipeline most likely reads the same mirror; that is inference, not a verified claim.

dailyProfile.updatePerformedBy: the Electron application, which manages this profile exclusively; the CLI refuses to modify it

releaseProcessNote: The 0.1.5 changelog lines were first written through a bash heredoc, which executed the backticked words as commands and silently dropped them from the text. The pin commit restores them. Release write-ups now use direct file writes, not shell heredocs.
whatWouldCountAsSuccess: A human review action (approve, return, or archive) in the daily desktop profile after the update lands.
One receipt export produced outside this machine's own testing.
One install that did not originate from a session where the author described the plugin.
